text: {"lessons":["I should set a suitable stock-and-cash allocation for retirement needs and review it on a regular schedule, instead of letting losses accumulate without checking my risk.","Selling many holdings after a sharp decline—and later selling another at a much larger loss—shows I need a written plan for when to hold, trim, or exit, rather than reacting to price drops alone.","Before any trade, I should consider each holding's role and my cash needs; I should neither sell solely to avoid further losses nor hold automatically without reassessing the risk."]}
